_comment: Evidence epoch registry (Codex audit 2026-05-18 X4). Every ROI report MUST name the epoch it was computed against, so contamination from older periods cannot silently mix into promotion math. The current_epoch_id selects which epoch is 'in effect'; any consumer that wants pre-reset data must explicitly request it by id. Until the 5/31 reset, current_epoch_id is the pre-freeze epoch; ops/maintenance/epoch_reset.py advances it post-reset.

epochs.label: Pre-freeze evidence (contaminated)
epochs.contamination_notes: Silent bugs only diagnosed/fixed in 5/14-5/18 window: CBOT routing (22 days of zero-fill on cuebanks/mamba/tori), Error 321 multi-expiry futures, EXIT FAILED cascade on argus FX (5/8 + 5/15 — left 184K GBPUSD + 42K CADJPY orphans), sizing-formula bug producing phantom 417-contract NQ trades. Pre-fix data is not usable for promotion math.

epochs.label: Clean post-reset evidence (target: 30 days through 6/30 for 7/1+ RM decision)
